program='''def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    # Locate the two matching foreground patterns and the separator/background.
    # Horizontal layout: two columns of objects separated by a solid column.
    seps=[c for c in range(w) if len({g[r][c] for r in range(h)})==1 and sum(g[r][c]!=g[r][c] for r in range(h))==0]
    # This task family has a full solid separator row or column.
    row_seps=[r for r in range(h) if len(set(g[r]))==1]
    col_seps=[c for c in range(w) if len({g[r][c] for r in range(h)})==1]
    if col_seps:
        s=col_seps[len(col_seps)//2]
        left=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(s) if g[r][c]!=g[r][s]]
        right=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(s+1,w) if g[r][c]!=g[r][s]]
        # Object rows have the same foreground positions in both copies.
        rows=sorted({r for r,c in left+right})
        lc=next(c for c in range(s) if any(g[r][c]!=g[r][s] for r in rows))
        rc=next(c for c in range(s+1,w) if any(g[r][c]!=g[r][s] for r in rows))
        dest=next((c for c in range(rc+1,w) if all(g[r][c]==g[r][s] for r in rows)),rc-1)
        bg=g[0][s]
        for r in rows:
            if g[r][lc]!=g[r][rc]:
                g[r][dest]=g[r][rc]
                g[r][rc]=bg
        return g
    s=row_seps[len(row_seps)//2]
    bg=g[s][0]
    top=next(r for r in range(s) if any(x!=bg for x in g[r]))
    bot=next(r for r in range(s+1,h) if any(x!=bg for x in g[r]))
    dest=next(r for r in range(s+1,h) if all(x==bg for x in g[r]))
    for c in range(w):
        if g[top][c]!=g[bot][c]:
            g[dest][c]=g[bot][c]
            g[bot][c]=bg
    return g
'''
